newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian metals steady in dull trade.
newsitem.headline: Indian metals steady in dull trade.

text.p: Metal prices were steady on Tuesday on the local market in dull trade, dealers said.
They said a Hindu religious festival had also affected trading.

Copper was unchanged at 30,425 rupees. Zinc was steady at 7,850 rupees per quintal. Aluminium was quiet at 7,450 rupees per quintal. Lead was offered at 4,550 rupees pwer quintal and tin was unchanged at 31,000 rupees per quintal. Nickel was unchanged at 35,800 rupees per quintal.
